content: {"phoneNote":"The framed hero card with the olive branch reads well and the shop photo peeks into the first screen, but further down address, hours, directions, phone and e-mail are all shown twice (contact section and footer).","desktopNote":"Below the hero the page loses density: product cards are mostly empty space around a price, the two gallery photos sit in the left half leaving the right half blank, and the contact block is repeated in the footer.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Merge the contact section and footer into one block: show address, directions, hours, phone and e-mail exactly once.","Give the product cards real product photos instead of the repeated olive-branch icon and shrink the oversized price; on desktop tighten the card height.","On desktop let the 'Utrinki iz trgovine' gallery span the full width (3–4 photos or larger crops) and add padding to the 'Darilni paketi' button so the label doesn't touch its edges."],"blockers":["Phone and desktop: the contact block (address, Navodila za pot, full opening-hours table, phone, e-mail) is repeated in the contact section and again in the footer."]}
